title: Bold Venture
paragraphs: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall star as Slate Shannon and Sailor Duval in a Caribbean adventure series centered on Shannon's Place in Havana and the charter boat Bold Venture, where smugglers, killers, revolutionaries, and desperate travelers draw them into danger.

plain_text:
Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall star as Slate Shannon and Sailor Duval in a Caribbean adventure series centered on Shannon's Place in Havana and the charter boat Bold Venture, where smugglers, killers, revolutionaries, and desperate travelers draw them into danger.

Star-led Caribbean adventure series produced for transcription syndication.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Ziv syndicated run (March 26, 1951 to September 15, 1952).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include David Friedkin (writer), David Rose (composer and conductor), Henry Hayward (director), Humphrey Bogart (performer), Lauren Bacall (performer), and Morton Fine (writer).

The stories often return to Caribbean adventure, Havana and Cuba, murder and homicide, boats, ships and maritime travel, treasure, jewels and valuables, and smuggling and contraband.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Ziv transcription syndication, Hollywood stars in syndicated radio, Caribbean adventure setting, and Calypso musical framing.
